title: DomainAtlas
description: ADR 0010: the MEASURED concept atlas — domains + co-deployment distances, plus the calibration verdict that gated it. It is the measured successor to the operator-curated domain_taxonomy: same domains/distances shape (so far-framing selection reads it unchanged), but distances are model-relative co-deployment (measured), and only a calibration-PASSED atlas is pinnable. honest_failure ships nothing (the operator table remains). distance_source MUST be co_deployment — topical (SPECTER2) is a separated baseline used only in the calibration gate, never the pinned primary.

distance_source.description: The PRIMARY distance must be measured co-deployment. Topical similarity is never the pinned primary (that is the declared/leaky distance A1/T1-03 reject).

measuring_model_id.description: The pinned model the co-deployment battery was measured on (provenance: distances are relative to this model).

calibration.description: ADR 0010 (T1-04): the result of the atlas's external-falsifier (calibration gate). Pre-registered band_threshold + delta + held-out set, verdict from atlas.validate.calibration_verdict. Only deployable / bounded_result are pinnable.

distances.description: Measured co-deployment distances in [0,1], keyed by sorted 'a|b' domain-id pairs (same convention as domain_taxonomy).

restricted_regions.description: Present iff calibration.verdict=bounded_result: the domain ids that cleared the calibration criterion. Far-framing uses measured distance only within this set; the operator table elsewhere (INV-restricted-membership).

source_provenance.description: Harness-stamped at pin time (atlas_sha256:<hash>), so a later construction cannot swap the atlas it is judged against.
